title: Wednesday, 6:34 a.m.
intro: A room above the bait shop. Everything is slightly too small, including you.

items.label: Red ribbon on the doorknob
items.text: The same red ribbon, the same neat bow. This is the second time somebody has dressed a set for you. You do not know that yet. You just feel looked after, and it is suspicious.

items.label: Mirror
items.text: A gentle giant of a face, with a beard that has opinions. Fingertips pruned. You flex your hands: they are the size of dinner plates.

items.label: Lemmy (cockatiel)
items.text: Lemmy goes absolutely silent. Then he drums his beak on the cage bar in a long, steady roll, and whistles four notes you somehow already know.

items.label: Cymbal case, tape box
items.text: Under the cymbals: a cassette marked REPLY in marker, and a 1961 snare chart in a boy's pencil, titled 'Mercy Roll'. A second sheet numbers every stroke, 1 to 212.

items.label: Desk: Salt Cathedral contract
items.text: A touring slot in Cleveland, signed last night at 11:58 p.m. Underneath, a folded note: 'Tell Lux.' Not yet crossed out.

items.label: Phone
items.text: A voicemail from Daniel Marsh: 'Don't make me find a new fish guy.' He is laughing in it, and then he isn't.

items.label: Shoebox of crayon drawings
items.text: Tobi's drawings, kept like treasure: JO IS A DRAGON. Next to the dragon, a smaller figure, blue, drawn with a line that looks wet.

items.label: Drum kit
items.text: A beaten-up kit with a damp patch under the floor tom that has never once dried. You tap the snare. It rings like a church bell down a long corridor.

items.label: Pancake pan
items.text: The band pancake pan. 3 p.m. every Sunday. It is the single most important object in the room.

items.label: Setlist
items.text: Tonight at The Low Water: Salt Water Hymn, Burn the Boats, a ballad called Please Stop Saying Goodbye (nobody in town knows why it sells).

items.label: HARROW poster
items.text: Four people looking sullen in front of the lake. One of them is smiling slightly. That one is you.

items.label: Single sock on the lamp
items.text: A sock. On a lamp. There's no story here. You respect it.
